declarations.name: VeraSelect
declarations.description: A single/multi select. Shadow DOM by default, `light` to opt out; supply your own trigger by slot or use the built-in one; form-associated, searchable, creatable, remote-filterable.

attributes.name: multi
attributes.description: Picking toggles membership and the menu stays open.

attributes.name: placeholder
attributes.description: Shown in the value area while nothing is selected.

attributes.name: light
attributes.description: Render into the light DOM instead of a shadow root. Read at connect.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The form field name — submitted via ElementInternals where supported.

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: An empty selection reports valueMissing to the owning form.

attributes.name: searchable
attributes.description: Show the filter line above the options.

attributes.name: creatable
attributes.description: A search matching no option offers a create row; implies the search line. See the create event.

attributes.name: remote
attributes.description: The host owns filtering: options render unfiltered, the search line shows, and edits emit the filter event (debounced 250ms by default).

attributes.name: loading
attributes.description: Announce an in-flight remote fetch in the empty area.

attributes.name: debounce
attributes.description: Milliseconds between the last keystroke and the filter event.

attributes.name: search-placeholder
attributes.description: Placeholder and accessible name of the search line. Default "Search…".

attributes.name: empty-message
attributes.description: Shown when no option matches. Default "No options".

attributes.name: overflow-message
attributes.description: A footer line under the list — "1,250 more results", consumer-worded.

attributes.name: aria-label
attributes.description: The accessible name, reflected onto the trigger (a page label cannot reach through the boundary). A <label for> associated via the form also works, through ElementInternals.

members.name: value
members.description: The selection — always an array, in both modes.

events.name: change
events.description: After every committed change. Bubbles and crosses the shadow boundary.

events.name: create
events.description: The create row was activated. Cancelable: preventDefault() to claim creation (async ids, dedup); uncanceled, `option` joins the options and is picked. Mutate `detail.option` to shape it.

events.name: filter
events.description: A debounced search edit — the remote seam. Fetch, then set `.options`.

slots.name: trigger
slots.description: Replace the whole control. Wired with role, aria, data-state and handlers.

slots.name: value
slots.description: Replace only the value area inside the default trigger; label text is kept in sync.

cssParts.name: value
cssParts.description: The value area inside the trigger.

cssParts.name: search
cssParts.description: The filter input. Present only when searchable/creatable/remote.

cssParts.name: list
cssParts.description: The listbox. Scroll is contained; ::part(list){overscroll-behavior:auto} opts out.

cssParts.name: option
cssParts.description: One row. Carries data-active, data-create on the create row, and aria-selected.

cssParts.name: empty
cssParts.description: The no-matches message; reads "Loading…" while the loading attribute is set.

cssParts.name: overflow
cssParts.description: The footer line, shown while overflow-message is set.

values: (present while the row is the keyboard-active one)
